welcome:
Welcome to the Azure CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated BFSI production environment in Central India.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: First, confirm which Azure subscription you are working in.
Good. Now list the AKS clusters in the payments resource group to find the affected cluster.
steps.hint: Try: az aks list --resource-group rg-payments-prod-centralindia -o table

steps.instruction: The cluster 'aks-payments-prod' looks unhealthy. Get its detailed status.
steps.expect: az aks show --name aks-payments-prod --resource-group rg-payments-prod-centralindia -o table
steps.hint: Try: az aks show --name aks-payments-prod --resource-group rg-payments-prod-centralindia -o table

steps.instruction: Check the node pools to see if any nodes are in a bad state.
steps.expect: az aks nodepool list --cluster-name aks-payments-prod --resource-group rg-payments-prod-centralindia -o table
steps.hint: Try: az aks nodepool list --cluster-name aks-payments-prod --resource-group rg-payments-prod-centralindia -o table

steps.instruction: The 'txnpool' node pool shows 1/3 nodes ready. Pull the cluster credentials so we can investigate with kubectl.
steps.hint: Try: az aks get-credentials --name aks-payments-prod --resource-group rg-payments-prod-centralindia

steps.instruction: Check Azure Monitor metrics for the cluster's CPU usage over the last hour.
steps.expect: az monitor metrics list --resource /subscriptions/a1b2c3d4/resourceGroups/rg-payments-prod-centralindia/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/aks-payments-prod --metric node_cpu_usage_percentage --interval PT1H -o table
steps.hint: Try: az monitor metrics list --resource /subscriptions/a1b2c3d4/resourceGroups/rg-payments-prod-centralindia/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/aks-payments-prod --metric node_cpu_usage_percentage --interval PT1H -o table

steps.instruction: CPU is spiking at 94%. Check the NSG rules on the cluster subnet to ensure traffic is not being blocked.
steps.expect: az network nsg rule list --nsg-name nsg-aks-payments-prod --resource-group rg-payments-prod-centralindia -o table
steps.hint: Try: az network nsg rule list --nsg-name nsg-aks-payments-prod --resource-group rg-payments-prod-centralindia -o table

steps.instruction: NSG rules look fine. The issue is resource exhaustion. Query Log Analytics for OOMKilled events in the last hour.
steps.expect: az monitor log-analytics query --workspace aks-la-workspace-prod --analytics-query "KubePodInventory | where ClusterName == 'aks-payments-prod' | where PodStatus == 'Failed' | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | project TimeGenerated, Name, PodStatus, ContainerStatusReason" -o table
steps.hint: Try: az monitor log-analytics query --workspace aks-la-workspace-prod --analytics-query "KubePodInventory | where ClusterName == 'aks-payments-prod' | where PodStatus == 'Failed' | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | project TimeGenerated, Name, PodStatus, ContainerStatusReason" -o table

scenarios.title: Deploy and Secure a Storage Account

steps.instruction: List existing resource groups to find where the audit data team keeps their resources.
Create a new storage account for regulatory audit logs in the compliance resource group.
steps.expect: az storage account create --name stauditlogsprod2026 --resource-group rg-compliance-prod-centralindia --location centralindia --sku Standard_ZRS --kind StorageV2 --min-tls-version TLS1_2
steps.hint: Try: az storage account create --name stauditlogsprod2026 --resource-group rg-compliance-prod-centralindia --location centralindia --sku Standard_ZRS --kind StorageV2 --min-tls-version TLS1_2

steps.instruction: Verify the storage account was created and check its properties.
steps.expect: az storage account show --name stauditlogsprod2026 --resource-group rg-compliance-prod-centralindia -o table
steps.hint: Try: az storage account show --name stauditlogsprod2026 --resource-group rg-compliance-prod-centralindia -o table

steps.instruction: Upload a sample audit report blob to a container called 'rbi-reports'.
steps.expect: az storage blob upload --account-name stauditlogsprod2026 --container-name rbi-reports --name 2026/Q2/audit-report.csv --file ./audit-report.csv --auth-mode login
steps.hint: Try: az storage blob upload --account-name stauditlogsprod2026 --container-name rbi-reports --name 2026/Q2/audit-report.csv --file ./audit-report.csv --auth-mode login

steps.instruction: List the blobs in the rbi-reports container to confirm the upload.
steps.expect: az storage blob list --account-name stauditlogsprod2026 --container-name rbi-reports -o table --auth-mode login
steps.hint: Try: az storage blob list --account-name stauditlogsprod2026 --container-name rbi-reports -o table --auth-mode login

steps.instruction: Store the storage account access key in Key Vault for safe rotation.
steps.expect: az keyvault secret set --vault-name kv-compliance-prod --name stauditlogs-key1 --value "REDACTED-use-az-storage-account-keys-list"
steps.hint: Try: az keyvault secret set --vault-name kv-compliance-prod --name stauditlogs-key1 --value "REDACTED-use-az-storage-account-keys-list"

steps.instruction: Verify who has access to this storage account by listing role assignments.
steps.hint: Try: az role assignment list --scope /subscriptions/a1b2c3d4/resourceGroups/rg-compliance-prod-centralindia/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/stauditlogsprod2026 -o table

steps.instruction: Good — only the compliance team has access. Finally, list all Key Vault secrets to confirm the key was stored.
steps.expect: az keyvault secret list --vault-name kv-compliance-prod -o table
steps.hint: Try: az keyvault secret list --vault-name kv-compliance-prod -o table

commands.help:
Available commands:
  az account show/list/set       — Manage subscriptions
  az group list/create           — Manage resource groups
  az vm list/show/start/stop     — Manage virtual machines
  az vm create                   — Create a virtual machine
  az aks list/show               — Manage AKS clusters
  az aks get-credentials         — Get cluster kubeconfig
  az aks nodepool list           — List node pools
  az storage account list/create — Manage storage accounts
  az storage blob list/upload    — Manage blobs
  az keyvault list/secret list   — Manage Key Vault & secrets
  az monitor metrics list        — Query Azure Monitor metrics
  az monitor log-analytics query — Query Log Analytics workspace
  az network nsg list/rule list  — Manage network security groups
  az ad user list                — List Azure AD users
  az role assignment list        — List RBAC role assignments

  scenario                       — Start a guided lab
  clear                          — Clear the terminal
  help                           — Show this help
